text:
Maya Chen: Heads-up — did a focused prefill + KV quantization run on orion-13b with FP8-KV vs INT8-KV. Results are weird: FP8 saves ~28% KV RSS but we see intermittent p99 spikes on coldpath when slot fragmentation happens.

Alex Gomez: Can you paste the perf numbers and config?

Maya Chen: Sure — run was 2k convo traces from prod-ish prompt set, batch=1, seq=1024, KV allocation policy=hashbank (new experiment), prefill_threshold=0.75.

Maya Chen: Summary:
- baseline (FP32 KV): mem_kv=10.2GB, p50=11ms, p95=45ms, p99=110ms
- INT8-KV: mem_kv=6.8GB, p50=12ms, p95=48ms, p99=125ms
- FP8-KV: mem_kv=4.9GB, p50=13ms, p95=60ms, p99=340ms (sporadic)

Rohit Verma: 340ms p99? that's massive. Any eviction logs around those spikes?

Maya Chen: Yes, pattern shows short-lived KV slot fragmentation -> more dequant ops hitting CPU fallback. We get a cascade: fragmented slots -> small scatter reads -> kernel doesn't vectorize well -> extra memcpy.

Sasha Li: What was the eval QA/regression? accuracy delta?

Maya Chen: Quick QA on 500 eval pairs (QA / few-shot): FP8-KV had -1.6% exact-match vs INT8-KV ~ -0.6% vs FP32 baseline. So FP8 looks slightly worse in fidelity in this workload.

Alex Gomez: Do we see any difference with `kv_prefill_stride` or increasing prefill_threshold to avoid partial slots?

Maya Chen: We tried `kv_prefill_stride=16 -> p99 drops to 180ms but p95 still up. Increasing prefill_threshold to 0.9 reduces fragmentation but memory saving also drops to ~20% vs FP32. Tradeoff.

Rohit Verma: Sounds like a microkernel / memory layout issue. Hypothesis: FP8 packing changes alignment causing more partial-vector loads for small-slot reads. Could add coalescing read path for fragmented slots.

Sasha Li: For rollout impact — FP8-KV gives good cost wins but QA drop and tail risk worry me. Suggest shadow canary with hybrid: FP8-KV for warm_cache hits, INT8-KV for coldpath, or dynamic fallback.

Alex Gomez: How hard is hybrid? runtime can route by slot 'is_prefilled' flag — adding a fallback dequant path is doable but need perf test.

Maya Chen: I'll sketch an experiment: 1) reproduce in smaller sim with controlled fragmentation, 2) implement read-coalesce for FP8 small reads, 3) run hybrid canary (warm=fp8, cold=int8) and record p99 and accuracy.

Alex Gomez: Thx. Can you upload the trace sample (one spike) to /tmp/kv-traces and drop link? Also include the raw malloc/free trace from the run.

Maya Chen: Uploaded: s3://redwood-dev/kv/3042107890/trace_spike_01.log and malloc profile at s3://redwood-dev/kv/3042107890/malloc.prof

Rohit Verma: I'll take coalescing read prototype, Sasha can you set up a shadow canary config in console for this run id?

Sasha Li: On it — creating canary with 1% traffic, enable KV metrics and alert p99>200ms.

Maya Chen: Plan to sync tomorrow after Rohit has initial microkernel patch. Thanks all :thumbsup:

Alex Gomez: Great. If hybrid works, we can ship an adaptive policy in Optimize: cost slider -> selects fp8/int8/cold fallback.
